reasonChirho: Massive mixed community (3022 senses) spanning marketplace, fields, shore, air, spatial prepositions, extremities. Primarily geographical objects and spatial features, secondarily spatial relations.
Set free/liberate, rescue/deliver, tear out, turn around physically — linear movement combined with saving/delivering actions.
Beat/strike/flog, knock at door, smite — physical impact actions. Third-person pronoun reference is a discourse referential mixed in.
Go out, depart, carry out, lead out, proceed from source — all linear movement verbs of exiting or emanating.
Do good, good moral quality, mercy, the good abstract — moral and ethical qualities with value assessment.
Possible, powerful, mighty, strong, able, capable — ability and power domain.
Indefinite generalizer, counterfactual conditional, subjunctive marker, temporal contingency — discourse markers and modal particles.
Worthy, deserving, sufficient, enough, content, satisfied, many — adequacy and qualification mixed with quantity.
Power, might, force, miraculous deeds, supernatural powers — power/force domain with supernatural beings overlap.
Both, third-person pronoun, those persons, plus harness/yoke and terrify — mixed discourse referentials with stray senses.
But, rather, and, except, unless, since, because — discourse markers expressing contrast, addition, and logical relations.
Take up into heaven, pick up, take on board, accept/receive a message, welcome a person — movement plus association.
Go, come, bring, lead, take physically, guide figuratively — linear movement and guidance.
Confirm, establish, prepare, make ready — readiness/preparation and coming into being.
Destruction, perdition, waste, squandering, corruption, decay — violence/harm/destroy domain.
Go up, ascend, grow up, ascend to heaven, set sail — upward linear movement, some maritime.
Fill up, fulfill, complete, accomplish, produce — performing and doing with aspect of completion.
Subjective negation, emphatic negation, interrogative negative, otherwise — affirmation/negation and discourse markers.
Take down, tear down, destroy, bring down, depose, go down, descend — downward movement and destruction.
Remain, be left over, leave behind, forsake, renounce, abandon — existence in space and dissociation.
Catch up in divine transport, snatch by force, plunder, seize physically, catch/entrap — forceful attachment and hostility.
Garment, clothing, put on, clothe oneself, clothe someone — activities involving clothing and artifacts.
Ungodly, impious, trouble, hardship, evil, wickedness, bad, harmful — moral/ethical qualities and trouble.
Great in size, greater/greatest, great in importance, great deeds, great in intensity — degree and status.
Lose, fail to keep, destroy, ruin, perish, be destroyed, corrupt — destruction and cessation of existence.
Gather together active and passive, call together, summon, convene, collect, bring together — movement toward unity.
Be terrified, dismayed, whirl/swirl, be brought forth — fear emotions mixed with physiological states of agitation.
Rejoicing, exultation, joy, delight, cry aloud, shout for joy — attitudes/emotions of gladness with vocal expression.
With, rejoice with, reclining with, accompany, come together — association and relational togetherness.
Look up, receive sight, see, perceive visually, beware, watch out — sensory events of visual perception.
Hidden, secret, hide, conceal, escape notice, be unaware — knowledge domain (concealment of information) and perception.
The same, that/those, that one, this/these — discourse referentials pointing to specific entities.
Cry out, shout, be called/surnamed, call upon, invoke, appeal legally, name/designate — communication and legal speech acts.
Just as, how, such as, which/what — comparison particles and interrogative-relative manner words.
Know, be acquainted with, be known, understand, learn, find out, make known, reveal — knowledge domain.
Depart, go away, pass over, move, relocate, pass by, pass away — linear movement and temporal transition.
Hoist a sail, be lifted up, raise voice, exalt oneself, high/lofty — stances/positions with status elevation.
Your/yours, you singular, 2nd person masculine/feminine singular — discourse referentials for addressee.
Do, act, perform, make, construct, create, produce, bear fruit, spend time, cause — performing/doing domain.
Close/intimate, draw near temporally, approach spatially, draw near to God, near — spatial positions and relational closeness.
Conduct oneself, live, go away, depart, pass away, journey, walk physically — behavior/lifestyle and movement.
Lay down, deposit, lay upon, inflict, place, put, lay down one's life — causing existence in a location.
Throw, cast, hurl, be thrown, put, place, lie sick, strike — movement of propulsion and impact.
If, in the event that, if not, except, unless, if indeed, or — conditional and disjunctive discourse markers.
Careless, useless, worthless, vain, empty, futile — value assessment (negative) and truth/falsity.
Rest, take rest, refresh, give rest, be refreshed, repose, resting place — physiological rest and relief from hardship.
Fall off, run aground, fall away spiritually, fail/become void, fall into — movement downward and behavioral failure.
Baby, infant, infancy, young child, immature, childish — people (age-based) and time of life.
Food, food, nourishment, decay — foods and condiments domain.
Depart physically, draw away, mislead, fall away in apostasy, purge, entrust — movement away combined with belief/trust.
